conventions: Measure formula `N בָּאַמָּה` → *N cubits* (4.2 ×3, 4.3): the numeral takes whatever preposition the ASV supplies before the measure (*of ten*, *of thirty*, *for ten*) under rule 33, or the copula where the measure is a verbless predicate (*was five*, 4.2); the בְּ and its assimilated article are `unrepresented` under rules 40 and 12, because *by the cubit* is the relation the ASV leaves unstated; אַמָּה takes *cubits*. Do not give the supplied *of* to the בְּ. The margin's *ten in a cubit* (4.3) was read and set aside.

Directive he in this chapter: it takes *toward* where no preposition stands on the noun (4.4 צָפוֹנָה, יָמָּה, נֶגְבָּה, מִזְרָחָה); in 4.10 `מִמּוּל נֶגְבָּה` → *toward the south* the *toward* is the compound preposition's (מִ + מּוּל fused under rule 30, headed on מִ) and the he is `unrepresented`, since the parallel 1KI.7.39 writes the same English for מִמּוּל נֶגֶב with no he at all; in 4.17 צְרֵדָתָה → *Zeredah* nothing is written for it. מִלְמַעְלָה → *above* (4.4) and בָּיְתָה → *inward*, קֵדְמָה → *eastward* fuse the he with its host under rules 30/32.

Supplied subject *it* for a participial predicate of the sea (4.4 עוֹמֵד → *It stood*, 4.5 מַחֲזִיק → *it received*) is `added`: the sea is written in 4.2, not in these verses (rule 10), the 4.4 הַיָּם stands in a later clause of its own (rule 25), and the 4.5 suffixes already hold *it*/*thereof*. The list's bare material nouns (זָהָב, נְחֹשֶׁת in 4.9, 4.16, 4.20–22) take their supplied *of*/*with* under rule 33 and the copula where the ASV writes one (4.22 *were of gold*), discontinuous around סָגוּר → *pure* and מָרוּק → *bright*.
report: Read all 41 candidate lemmas against the verses. Every multi-treatment bucket is licensed by the source or by the ASV's own wording: the unrepresented articles (4.11/4.16 'king Solomon', 4.13 'each network', 4.15 'one sea', 4.18 'these vessels', 4.9 agreement article) each answer to an ASV that wrote no separate 'the'; the measure bə of 'N בָּאַמָּה' is unrepresented in every one of its four occurrences (4.2 ×3, 4.3) with the supplied of/for on the numeral; the directive he takes 'toward' only where no preposition stands (4.4 ×4) and is unrepresented where מִמּוּל holds it (4.10) or nothing is written (4.17).

Added units read end to end (10): the supplied subject 'it' of the participial predicates in 4.4 and 4.5 is added in both, on the same ground (the sea is named only in an earlier verse or later in the verse; the suffixes in 4.5 already hold pronouns); the supplied object 'them' of 4.7 and 4.8 is added in both; the relative 'which' over the bare prepositional attribute in 4.12 is added while the written אֲשֶׁר of 4.12b/4.13/4.19 takes its own 'that'; 'as for' and 'to wit' in 4.22 and the asyndetic 'and' of 4.5/4.21 follow rules 14 and 16. No split found.

Construct-chain determiners are consistent across 4.7, 4.9, 4.11–4.13, 4.17–4.19, 4.22: an arthrously rendered rectum gives its article the second 'the' and the construct a supplied one; an anarthrous or attributively rendered rectum (of gold, of God, golden, clay, right) gives the article the fronted 'the'. Supplied 'the' before 'two X' goes to the counted noun in 4.12 and 4.13 alike (rule 15).

BSB disagreements are all convention: measure bə (rule 40), object markers (rule 16), agreement/demonstrative/distributive articles (rules 41, 47), doubled סָבִיב and 'from brim to brim' suffixes (rule 22), repeated בֵּין (rule 26), the two directive he's, and the unrendered object suffix of לְבַעֲרָם ('to burn', ASV writes no 'them'). None is an error.

Single-verse judgments left as the verse pass made them, each already carrying its competing reading: 4.4 'was set upon' read as the construction's linking frame rather than 'set' added; 4.3 'which did compass' read as an articleless attributive (rule 41) rather than 'which' added; 4.6 'such things as belonged' headed on things; 4.5 'was wrought' with the copula on the recast noun rather than on the כְּ.
No promotion: the chapter's recurring constructions are already the contract's (rules 15, 29, 32, 33, 40, 51), and 1KI.7 precedent for the measure formula and 'was set upon' was not in the packet.
